description: We’re building an interactive Mars survival map for NASA Space Apps 2026 to help astronauts explore safely and do meaningful science. We plan to combine real NASA terrain, imagery, weather, radiation, and hazard data into an easy to use map with routes, safety alerts, and a return to base feature. We’re looking for curious teammates skilled in coding, web maps, data analysis, Mars science, UI/UX design, or storytelling. Join us to make Mars exploration safer and smarter!
